entries.Original: This walkthrough explains how to set up Ascended Rotation Solver Reborn and what each section controls and includes recommended macros.
entries.Translated: 本教程介绍如何设置创造天地循环求解器 Reborn，以及各部分的控制内容，并包含推荐宏。

entries.Original: Open the config with /rotation or the plugin UI button.
entries.Translated: 使用 /rotation 或插件界面按钮打开配置。

entries.Original: Use Next/Back to move through sections and apply changes as you go.
entries.Translated: 使用下一步/上一步浏览各个部分，并随时应用更改。

entries.Original: Most settings are safe to change while logged in, but avoid in-combat tweaks until you’re comfortable.
entries.Translated: 大多数设置可在登录时安全更改，但在熟悉之前请避免在战斗中调整。

entries.Original: Right-click any setting or action label to copy its macro command.
entries.Translated: 右键点击任意设置或技能标签可复制其宏命令。

entries.Original: Main is your overview hub: plugin info, compatibility info, links, and macro list live here.
entries.Translated: 主界面是你的概览中心：插件信息、兼容性信息、链接和宏列表都在这里。

entries.Original: Use this tab to verify incompatible plugins and open support links.
entries.Translated: 使用此标签页检查不兼容的插件并打开支持链接。

entries.Original: Read the macros section to learn quick chat commands.
entries.Translated: 阅读宏部分以了解快捷聊天命令。

entries.Original: If something breaks after an update, check this tab first.
entries.Translated: 如果更新后出现问题，请先检查此标签页。

entries.Original: Job config controls rotation selection and job-specific options for your current class.
entries.Translated: 职业配置控制当前职业的循环选择及职业专属选项。

entries.Original: Pick the rotation preset you want to run by clicking the rotation name (ie. Reborn).
entries.Translated: 点击循环名称（例如 Reborn）选择要运行的循环预设。

entries.Original: Adjust job priorities (e.g., DNC partner, SGE Kardia) when applicable.
entries.Translated: 在适用时调整职业优先级（如 DNC 舞伴、SGE 心关）。

entries.Original: If a job feels off, start here before touching global settings.
entries.Translated: 如果某个职业手感不对，先从这里调整，再动全局设置。

entries.Original: Actions config decides what abilities RSR can use and how they behave.
entries.Translated: 技能配置决定 RSR 可以使用哪些技能以及它们的行为方式。

entries.Original: Click an action icon in a category to see settings to enable/disable it or change its usage rules.
entries.Translated: 点击分类中的技能图标，可查看启用/禁用该技能或更改其使用规则的设置。

entries.Original: Use intercept if you want RSR to fire actions you queue manually.
entries.Translated: 如果希望 RSR 触发你手动排队的技能，请使用拦截。

entries.Original: Toggle cooldown window inclusion so overlays show only what you want.
entries.Translated: 切换冷却窗口的包含范围，让悬浮窗只显示你想要的内容。

entries.Original: Auto controls global action usage, AoE logic, interrupts, tinctures, and healing behavior.
entries.Translated: 自动控制全局技能使用、AoE 逻辑、打断、爆发药与治疗行为。

entries.Original: Here you can adjust your AOE logic, (Off, Cleave, and Full).
entries.Translated: 在此可调整 AoE 逻辑（关闭、顺劈、完整）。

entries.Original: Adjust healer thresholds and non-healer support options.
entries.Translated: 调整治疗阈值与非治疗支援选项。

entries.Original: If you want a more conservative rotation, tighten these settings first.
entries.Translated: 如果你想要更保守的循环，请先收紧这些设置。

entries.Original: Basic contains core timing and automation behaviors that affect all jobs.
entries.Translated: 基础包含影响所有职业的核心时序与自动化行为。

entries.Original: Action Ahead affects weave count and clipping—smaller values = more oGCDs. You typically don't need to change this.
entries.Translated: 技能提前量影响插入数量与卡顿——数值越小 = 更多能力技。通常无需更改。

entries.Original: Min Updating Time trades performance for responsiveness.
entries.Translated: 最小更新间隔以性能换取响应速度。

entries.Original: Auto Switch controls when RSR turns on/off automatically (countdowns, deaths, duty events).
entries.Translated: 自动开关控制 RSR 何时自动开启/关闭（倒计时、死亡、任务事件）。

entries.Original: UI controls overlays, info windows, and Teaching Mode highlights.
entries.Translated: 界面控制悬浮窗、信息窗口与教学模式高亮。

entries.Original: Enable Control, Next Action, Cooldown, and Timeline windows here.
entries.Translated: 在此启用控制、下一步技能、冷却与时间轴窗口。

entries.Original: Use Teaching Mode to highlight hotbar buttons and learn rotations visually.
entries.Translated: 使用教学模式高亮热键栏按钮，直观学习循环。

entries.Original: If you want windows to only show in duty/with enemies, toggle that option here.
entries.Translated: 如果希望窗口仅在任务中/有敌人时显示，请在此切换该选项。

entries.Original: Target controls what enemies or allies RSR considers valid.
entries.Translated: 选定目标控制 RSR 认为哪些敌人或队友有效。

entries.Original: Tune vision cone and engage behavior to avoid unwanted pulls.
entries.Translated: 调整视野锥与接敌行为，避免意外引怪。

entries.Original: Configure target priority rules (FATE, quest mobs, markers).
entries.Translated: 配置选定目标优先级规则（FATE、任务怪、标记）。

entries.Original: If targeting feels wrong, adjust filters before changing rotations.
entries.Translated: 如果选定目标感觉不对，请先调整过滤器再更改循环。

entries.Original: List manages curated status lists: dispels, priority targets, knockbacks, and more.
entries.Translated: 列表管理精选状态列表：驱散、优先目标、击退等。

entries.Original: Use Reset and Update to restore curated lists when needed.
entries.Translated: 需要时使用重置与更新恢复精选列表。

entries.Original: Add or remove statuses by ID or name using the + buttons.
entries.Translated: 使用 + 按钮按 ID 或名称添加或移除状态。

entries.Original: These lists drive smart reactions across all jobs.
entries.Translated: 这些列表驱动所有职业的智能反应。

entries.Original: Duty holds encounter‑specific toggles for special behavior.
entries.Translated: 任务包含特定遭遇战的特殊行为开关。

entries.Original: Most of these at the moment can be left enabled but there will be more granular controls in the future.
entries.Translated: 目前大部分可保持启用，但未来会有更精细的控制。

entries.Original: These settings override general targeting/rotation behavior in specific fights.
entries.Translated: 这些设置会在特定战斗中覆盖通用的选定目标/循环行为。

entries.Original: Extra is for advanced or experimental tweaks.
entries.Translated: 额外用于高级或实验性调整。

entries.Original: Animation lock and cooldown delay tweaks for those not using BMR.
entries.Translated: 为不使用 BMR 的用户提供的动画锁定与冷却延迟调整。

entries.Original: Only change these if you understand the side effects.
entries.Translated: 仅在了解副作用的情况下更改这些设置。

entries.Original: Starter macros let you control RSR quickly without opening the UI.
entries.Translated: 起始宏让你无需打开界面即可快速控制 RSR。

entries.Original: Use the macros below to toggle Auto/Manual/Off instantly.
entries.Translated: 使用下方宏可即时切换自动/手动/关闭。

entries.Original: Right-click any setting or action to copy its macro command.
entries.Translated: 右键点击任意设置或操作以复制其宏命令。

entries.Original: Build a small macro bar for fast in combat control.
entries.Translated: 构建一个小型宏栏，用于战斗中的快速控制。
既不是 PvE 也不是 PvP！
没有已排队的拦截操作。

entries.Translated: 确定要重置所有插件设置吗？

entries.Original: This is often recommended for users having issues while using an installation of RSR using an outdated default configuration.
entries.Translated: 对于使用过时默认配置安装 RSR 并遇到问题的用户，通常建议执行此操作。

entries.Translated: 感谢使用创造天地 Rotation Solver Reborn！

entries.Original: Simply right clicking any action, setting, or toggle will pop up the macro associated with it.
entries.Translated: 右键点击任意动作、设置或开关即可弹出对应的宏。

entries.Original: Right-click any action, setting, or toggle to view/copy its macro chat command.
entries.Translated: 右键点击任意技能、设置或开关，可查看/复制其宏聊天命令。

entries.Original: Use /rsr as a shorter alias for /rotation.
entries.Translated: 可使用 /rsr 作为 /rotation 的简写别名。

entries.Original: Use /rotation Auto, /rotation Manual, or /rotation Off to change modes quickly.
entries.Translated: 使用 /rotation Auto、/rotation Manual 或 /rotation Off 快速切换模式。

entries.Original: Use the search box (top-left) to jump directly to settings.
entries.Translated: 使用搜索框（左上角）可直接跳转到设置项。

entries.Original: Click the external-link icon in search results to jump to that menu.
entries.Translated: 点击搜索结果中的外部链接图标可跳转到对应菜单。

entries.Original: Right-click a setting label to copy a ready-to-use /rotation Settings command.
entries.Translated: 右键点击设置标签可复制可直接使用的 /rotation Settings 命令。

entries.Original: Actions tab: click an action icon to configure, enable/disable, or set hotkeys.
entries.Translated: 技能标签页：点击技能图标可进行配置、启用/禁用或设置快捷键。

entries.Original: Actions: toggle 'Show on CD Window' to include an action in the cooldown overlay.
entries.Translated: 技能：开启“在冷却窗口中显示”可将技能加入冷却悬浮窗。

entries.Original: Actions: enable 'Intercepted' to let RSR fire an action you queue (PvE only).
entries.Translated: 技能：启用“拦截”可让 RSR 释放你排队的技能（仅 PvE）。

entries.Original: UI > Information: enable DTR status, toasts, original cooldowns, and these hints.
entries.Translated: 界面 > 信息：启用 DTR 状态、提示弹窗、原始冷却时间及这些提示。

entries.Original: UI > Windows: enable Next Action, Control, Cooldown, and Timeline windows.
entries.Translated: 界面 > 窗口：启用下一个技能、控制、冷却和时间轴窗口。

entries.Original: Next Action: 'No Inputs' and 'No Move' options change overlay behavior.
entries.Translated: 下一个技能：“无输入”和“不移动”选项会改变悬浮窗行为。

entries.Original: Only show windows in duty or with enemies: UI > Windows > Only show with hostile or in duty.
entries.Translated: 仅在任务中或存在敌人时显示窗口：界面 > 窗口 > 仅在敌对目标或任务中显示。

entries.Original: List tab: manage dispels, priority statuses, knockbacks, invincibility, and no-casting lists.
entries.Translated: 列表标签页：管理驱散、优先级状态、击退、无敌和无施法列表。

entries.Original: List tab: use 'Reset and Update' to restore curated lists quickly.
entries.Translated: 列表标签页：使用“重置并更新”可快速恢复精选列表。

entries.Original: Status lists: press '+' to search by name or ID; fuzzy search is supported.
entries.Translated: 状态列表：按“+”可按名称或 ID 搜索；支持模糊搜索。

entries.Original: Status lists: right-click an icon to remove; Delete key works in the popup too.
entries.Translated: 状态列表：右键点击图标可移除；弹窗中也可使用 Delete 键。

entries.Original: Target tab: tweak target selection, vision cone, engage behavior, and dummy/boss handling.
entries.Translated: 目标标签页：调整目标选择、视野锥、接敌行为以及木桩/Boss 处理。

entries.Original: Target tab: set /rotation Cycle behaviour and targeting delays.
entries.Translated: 目标标签页：设置 /rotation 循环行为与选定目标延迟。

entries.Original: Manage TargetingTypes via chat: /rotation Settings TargetingTypes add|remove <Type>.
entries.Translated: 通过聊天管理选定目标类型：/rotation Settings TargetingTypes add|remove <Type>。

entries.Original: Auto > Action Usage: allow/deny oGCDs, set AoE style, tinctures, interrupts, and True North.
entries.Translated: 自动 > 技能使用：允许/禁止能力技、设置 AoE 方式、爆发药、打断和真北。

entries.Original: Auto > Healing: adjust thresholds and non-healer healing behavior.
entries.Translated: 自动 > 治疗：调整阈值和非治疗职业的治疗行为。

entries.Original: Healer: customize Raise/Swiftcast and prioritization in Auto > Healing.
entries.Translated: 治疗职业：在 自动 > 治疗 中自定义复活/即刻咏唱及优先级。

entries.Original: Ground AoEs: Auto > Healing has options to place beneficial ground actions smartly.
entries.Translated: 地面 AoE：自动 > 治疗 中有智能放置增益地面技能的选项。

entries.Original: Basic > Timer: tune Action Ahead and Min Updating Time to balance performance vs weaving.
entries.Translated: 基础 > 计时器：调整提前施放和最小更新时间，以平衡性能与插入技能。

entries.Original: Basic > Auto Switch: auto on/off for countdowns, deaths, area transitions, and more.
entries.Translated: 基础 > 自动切换：倒计时、死亡、区域切换等自动开/关。

entries.Original: Teaching Mode highlights targets; color is in UI > Information.
entries.Translated: 教学模式会高亮目标；颜色在 UI > 信息 中设置。

entries.Original: Job tab: edit DNC partner, SGE Kardia tank, and AST card priorities when on those jobs.
entries.Translated: 职业标签页：在对应职业时编辑舞者舞伴、贤者心关坦克和占星卡牌优先级。

entries.Original: About > Macros lists available chat/macro commands and helpful syntax.
entries.Translated: 关于 > 宏：列出可用的聊天/宏命令及实用语法。

entries.Original: About > Links: open config folder, GitHub, Ko-fi, and Discord.
entries.Translated: 关于 > 链接：打开配置文件夹、GitHub、Ko-fi 和 Discord。
额外 > 内部：安全地备份/恢复配置。

entries.Original: Extra: optional tweaks like removing animation/cooldown delay.
entries.Translated: 额外：可选调整，如移除动画/冷却延迟。

entries.Original: Click the cube icon at the bottom-left of the sidebar to copy diagnostic info to clipboard.
entries.Translated: 点击侧边栏左下角的方块图标，将诊断信息复制到剪贴板。

entries.Original: Timeline window can visualize recent actions (UI > Windows).
entries.Translated: 时间轴窗口可可视化近期技能（UI > 窗口）。

entries.Original: Healing: the only HP that matters is the last one
entries.Translated: 治疗：唯一重要的血量是最后一点

entries.Original: You can remove some self-buffs with “/statusoff <Name>” (e.g., Peloton) when needed.
entries.Translated: 需要时可用“/statusoff <Name>”移除部分自身增益（如速行）。

entries.Original: RSR works best with Legacy Type movement settings.
entries.Translated: RSR 在传统类型移动设置下效果最佳。
